headline: Revenue +14% (+13% cc) with North America +13% and Asia +24%; adjusted EPS $4.59 beat and FY27 outlook raised.
guidance_note: FY27 cc revenue growth raised to ~5-6% (52-week basis) with higher adj. operating margin expansion; Q2 guided +5-6% cc, margin +80-100 bps.
key_messages: North America revenue +13% to $740M; NA retail comps +9%; NA operating margin 23.1% (+240 bps).
Asia revenue +24% reported (+25% cc) to $589M, comps +23%; China reportedly up more than 40%.
Europe revenue +7% reported (+5% cc) to $594M; Europe operating margin flat at 26.4%.
Gross margin 73.7% (+140 bps); adjusted EPS $4.59, up 22% from $3.77; inventory down ~5%.

consumer.big_ticket: Double-digit North America growth with 9% retail comps signals firm demand for full-price premium apparel.
consumer.pricing: Outlook raised while navigating tariffs and macro uncertainty; no tariff cost figure found.

macro_read: Affluent US shoppers kept buying premium apparel at full price through spring 2026, pointing to resilient upper-income discretionary spending.
notes: Growth is as reported; a constant-currency North America figure was not found. North America retail comps are in the key messages.
EPS consensus null: sources cite $4.30, $4.32 and $4.45; revenue consensus also unconfirmed (one source $1.923B).
AUR figure for the quarter not found.
The gross-margin change shown is the reported change; adjusted change not confirmed. Reported diluted EPS was $4.28.

sources.label: FashionNetwork: RL revenue +14% in FY27 Q1
